title: Score, best score and speed ramp: the score counts distance, the speed grows with the score up to a cap, the best score survives restarts and the page persists it
body:
## Context

t1 (jump) and t2 (obstacles, collision, restart) are on `main`. `state.score` is always 0 and `state.speed` never changes, so a run neither gets harder nor tells the player how far they got; the renderer already prints `state.score` zero-padded at the top right. This ticket makes the score real, ramps the speed with it, keeps a best score across restarts, and has the page persist that best in the browser.

## Scope

1. `src/tuning.js` (additive): `score: { pxPerPoint }` (e.g. 10 px of distance per point), `ramp: { pointsPerStep, speedStep, speedMax }` (every `pointsPerStep` points the speed grows by `speedStep`, never above `speedMax`).
2. `src/game.js`:
   - export `speedFor(score)`: a pure function, `TUNING.speed + floor(score / pointsPerStep) * speedStep`, capped at `speedMax`.
   - each tick (before the world scrolls): `state.score = floor(state.distance / pxPerPoint)` and `state.speed = speedFor(state.score)`.
   - new field `state.best` (integer, starts at the `best` argument of `createGame(seed, best = 0)`); on the tick the run ends, `state.best = max(state.best, state.score)`; the t2 restart keeps `best` and resets everything else.
3. `src/storage.js` (new, browser-free): `loadBest(storage)` and `saveBest(storage, best)` over an injected `{ getItem, setItem }` object under the key `dino-runner.best`; a missing or malformed value loads as 0. `index.html` passes `window.localStorage` (guarded with try/catch: a page with no storage still runs), seeds `createGame` with the loaded best and saves on game over.
4. `src/render.js`: also draw `HI <best>` (zero-padded to 5) to the left of the score.
5. Tests (`tests/score.test.mjs`): the criteria below; existing tests stay green (the replay test too — nothing here draws randomness).
6. Docs, in the same commit as the rule: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (`best`, `speedFor`, storage), `docs/TICKETS.md` (t3 to Done), `DECISIONS.md` D5 (nothing left absent from the three tickets).

## Acceptance criteria

- C1. After `n` `NO_INTENT` ticks on a fresh run (before any obstacle can be hit, e.g. n = 50), `state.score === Math.floor(state.distance / TUNING.score.pxPerPoint)`.
- C2. `speedFor(0) === TUNING.speed`; `speedFor` is non-decreasing over 0..100000; `speedFor(1e9) === TUNING.ramp.speedMax`; and during a run `state.speed === speedFor(state.score)` on every tick.
- C3. A run that ends with score S leaves `state.best === Math.max(previousBest, S)`; `createGame(1, 42).best === 42`; after a t2 restart `best` is unchanged while `score === 0`.
- C4. `loadBest` on a storage whose `getItem` returns `null`, `"abc"` or `"-5"` returns 0; `saveBest(storage, 17)` then `loadBest(storage)` returns 17 (fake storage object in the test); `src/storage.js` passes `npm run lint` (no browser globals — the storage is injected).
- C5. `render(fakeCtx, state)` with a fake context that records `fillText` calls emits a string containing `HI` and the zero-padded best (e.g. `HI 00042` for best 42) and the zero-padded score.
- C6. `index.html` contains the read (`loadBest`) at startup and the write (`saveBest`) on the tick the run ends — verified by reading the file and by a `node` probe that imports `src/storage.js` (no browser needed for the rule; the page wiring is checked by inspection and named as such in the verdict).
- C7. `npm run play -- --ticks 900 --every 100 --seed 7` ends with a summary where `score > 0` and `speed >= TUNING.speed`; with the ramp, `speed` in the summary is greater than `TUNING.speed` for a run that reaches `pointsPerStep` points.
- C8. The gates are green on the integrated tree: `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build`.

## Out of scope

Leaderboards, a day/night cycle, sound on milestones, ducking, birds.

## References

`docs/TICKETS.md` (t3), `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `src/game.js`, `src/tuning.js`, `src/render.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/play.mjs`, `tests/`.
